crest.alpha: RGBA, transparent exterior; rendered with nearest filtering
crest.prompt: Create one production game UI ornament asset on a genuinely transparent background, no text. Grimdark fantasy pixel art for Omega Realm, inspired by old Diablo inventory UI: a small front-facing weathered bone skull embedded in a narrow symmetrical dark iron and tarnished gold gothic crest, with a pointed top finial, tiny worn rivets, short thorn-like metal wings. Single compact horizontal ornament centered, tight composition, roughly 3:2 aspect ratio. Pixel art with deliberate hard pixel clusters, no smooth painterly shading, no blur, no soft shadow outside silhouette, no glow. Muted black iron #252928, antique gold #9B7428, bone #D8D0BC, dried blood #4A1512, bright highlights very restrained. Design to read when rendered at 120x80 pixels over a black menu panel and also as a compact health emblem. Transparent everywhere outside the crest. Only the crest, no UI panels, no background, no checkerboard, no lettering. Save the generated asset to disk and return its path.

Cyan spectral running figure and motion streaks; blood-red charge slash with ivory impact; violet hooded rogue dissolving into shadows with silver dagger; golden-white magical star explosion. Near-black textured backgrounds, hard pixel clusters, clear silhouettes designed for small inventory skill icons.

surfaces.usage: Iron on everyday panels and buttons, with silver/iron SVG rims and small bronze sigil/focus accents. HUD hardware and the frameless death action retain muted aged bronze. Crimson primary buttons use tinted iron. Blood source retained as unused artwork; it is not loaded by the shared theme.

prompts.iron: Square full-bleed blackened forged iron, charcoal slate, fine hammered grain, faint scratches and smoky patina with subtle violet undertones. Dark quiet center for overlaid text; no frames, lettering, objects or UI.
prompts.blood: Square full-bleed ancient blackened iron stained with dry oxblood and abraded crimson lacquer. Dried blood and scratches concentrated at edges, center 60 percent dark and quiet; no frames, lettering, objects or UI.
